FAQ

Common questions.

Will it promise refunds or discounts?
It works from what you tell it. If you mention a refund or a credit in the context, it can include it. Read it over before you send it — it's your name on it.
Can I use it for reviews and texts too?
Yes. Paste any customer message — an email, a text or an online review — and copy the reply wherever you need it.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Customer Response Drafter is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
